tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: Microsoft CoPilot is available for University of Sussex students.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.quote: However, you must not use Grammarly’s generative AI features (including: drafting new text, rewriting paragraphs, reorganising your argument, paraphrasing large sections, or generating references) unless the assessment instructions explicitly permit such use and you follow any required acknowledgement guidelines.
The full functionality of AI tools are usually only available via subscription, which we would discourage anyone from doing on an individual basis.

data.quote: You should never share personal or sensitive information with AI tools.
Even when using Copilot, never share sensitive information such as names, addresses, health data, passwords or unpublished research.

If you’re working with University of Sussex data, always use Microsoft Copilot via your Sussex account.

safeguards.quote: Before using any AI tool, make sure you read its terms of use.
If you use any other AI tool, make sure to opt out of data collection whenever possible.
If you’re working with University of Sussex data, always use Microsoft Copilot via your Sussex account.

legal.quote: Before using any AI tool, make sure you read its terms of use.
